_about: Carbon dioxide (1) + Water (2): equilibrium states (T, P, x, y), 294.57-345.57 K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record, compositions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2.

source.citation: X. Luo, L. Su, H. Gao, X. Wu, R. Idem, P. Tontiwachwuthikul, Z. Liang, Density, Viscosity and N2O solubility of Aqueous 2- (methylamino)ethanol Solution, J. Chem. Eng. Data 62 (2017) 129-140
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 5. The table number in the article was not checked.
source.transcription: Read from the ThermoML XML by validation/python/hp_gas_solubility.py; values as stored. The person checking compares each row with the record.

notes: Read with validation/python/hp_gas_solubility.py. The record gives the molality m of carbon dioxide (mol per kg of water); x_1 = m / (m + 1000/M_2), M_2 = 18.01528 g/mol. The record gives the partial pressure of carbon dioxide (p_1_kPa), not the total pressure. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
